technical: chosen supported player steps resolved or explicitly refused
physical requests include continuations and failed attempts
actual input/output usage or explicitly missing
confirmed display latency distinct from provider latency
semantic: important narrated commitments/facts missing from memory
narration contradicts authoritative arrival or other mechanics
NPC uses information not legitimately known
prior agreement reopened or lost after context removal

narrative.method: human assessment after seeing complete outputs; no extra model calls
narrative.scale: 1 poor, 3 adequate, 5 strong, with a concrete quoted reason; exploratory, not statistical

fairness: same initial state and player input per case
N1 later branches may legitimately diverge
no identical end-state requirement for different fiction
unrun_result: No comparative quality, reliability, memory adequacy or request savings can be concluded before authorized natural execution.
